page.layout: One page of text, single column, with a woodcut ornament above the title. Title block centred: "Præfatio" / "ad" / "Lectorem." Body text below in one column. Catchword at the lower right. No margin notes. Faint show-through from the other side of the leaf is not transcribed.

main_text.head: Præfatio ad Lectorem.
main_text.p: Sisto tibi tandem, bene-vole Lector! elegantissi-mam hanc Introductionem in Historiam universalem, quæ, cùm ob precium suum, quo habui, in scrinio meo hactenus latitaverit, ob maximum usum, qui etiam visus est celeberrimis Viris, quibus copiam ejus feci, diutius Tibi de-esse haud debuit.
Quàm enim necessaria sit Summaria quædam notitia vastum Histo-

page.notes: The initial S is a large drop capital, joined to "isto" as "Sisto". The word "Præfatio" is set in small italic type, "ad" in roman, and "Lectorem." in large italic. The catchword "riæ" is the start of the next page's text and is kept out of the paragraph. The signature "A 2" is faint; the final digit is uncertain. Faint show-through text in the margins is excluded.
